ishihara2018_kir21_unitary@1.locator: Fig. 4B–C, wild-type mouse Kir2.1, inward unitary slope of the i–V relation.
ishihara2018_kir21_unitary@1.scope: Figure readings, not tabulated slopes. The pipette supplies the extracellular patch solution. Cell-attached recordings leave intracellular K activity unknown. The published power fit uses activity in the Na-substitution series. Cells takes concentrations.

matsuda1991_ventricular_unitary@1.locator: Figs. 1–2 and accompanying group slope estimates, open-cell-attached guinea-pig ventricular patches, Mg-free cytoplasm.
matsuda1991_ventricular_unitary@1.scope: The two rows at 150 mM internal K compare quasi-linear single-channel slopes with sugar substitution outside. Molecular identity was unresolved. The third row changes the inside concentration.

jager2001_kv15_potassium@1.locator: Fig. 2, wild-type human Kv1.5 peak outward current in RBL cells.
jager2001_kv15_potassium@1.scope: Approximate ratios within each pH condition. Authors describe the normal-pH peaks as similar. No group error or sample count given for these ratios. Intracellular free K was not measured. The pipette was titrated with KOH to pH 7.2.

piasta2011_valinomycin_local@1.locator: Appendix B, Fig. B1, diamond markers after valinomycin addition. Example bilayer and blocked-channel baseline.
piasta2011_valinomycin_local@1.scope: The ±1.3 mV belongs to the channel-minus-carrier reversal difference over four comparisons. Pointwise current uncertainty and ion activities for the plotted curve are unavailable. Use only the narrow window actually covered by the carrier points.

leibner2009_hsa_eptfe@1.locator: Fig. 4 and Results §3.3, radiolabel distribution in one of three adsorption experiments.
leibner2009_hsa_eptfe@1.scope: Bound fraction of adsorbed label after PBS rinses. Mass recovery exceeded 95% for the three trials. No uncertainty for these individual fractions, and substantial between-trial variation.

goyama2023_hsa_eptfe@1.locator: Fig. 2 and protein adsorption methods, uncoated graft controls, post-wash extracted human serum albumin.
goyama2023_hsa_eptfe@1.scope: Uncoated ePTFE was water-washed before protein extraction and quantification. Reported mean and SD retain the paper’s units. The rinse effluent and pre-wash bound mass were unmeasured.

garrahan1967_ghost_phosphate_label@1.locator: Primary report, nucleotide labelling in resealed human erythrocyte ghosts, 15 min incorporation.
garrahan1967_ghost_phosphate_label@1.scope: High internal K and external Na increased radiophosphate incorporation above background. Ouabain suppressed the extra signal. The measured quantity is isotope entering nucleotides.

lant1968_ghost_phosphate_label@1.locator: Primary report, human erythrocyte ghosts, membrane and soluble nucleotide fractions.
lant1968_ghost_phosphate_label@1.scope: The gradient-dependent ATP label was ouabain-sensitive. Ion-independent incorporation persisted. A label can enter by exchange at zero net ATP production.

sahore2018_passive_bead_split@1.locator: Fig. 6d, field-off control showing the parent and two separated daughter droplets.
sahore2018_passive_bead_split@1.observed: Beads visible in both daughter droplets of the illustrated split.
sahore2018_passive_bead_split@1.scope: No per-split volume calibration, count table or replicated passive occupancy fraction. The adjacent 59% withdrawal estimate was obtained during magnetic retention and is excluded.

kehl2002_tail_protocol.locator: Fig. 2 and electrophysiology Methods, positive external K rows.
kehl2002_tail_protocol.scope: Each within-K pair compares the fitted maximum of onset tail currents. KOH titration leaves total intracellular K unreported. Control and acid tails have the same sign within each K level. The +65 mV acidic endpoint is outside the native gate domain.
